summary: Three adversarial controls reproduce and sharpen committed Alpha concerns. Broader support claims, deletion-cardinality substitution and omission of any scalar equality guard fail. The inspected manuscript and implementations retain the necessary restrictions; no new theorem counterexample or required revision was found. No compiler or full replay was run.

findings.statement: Each of the three hub scalar equality guards is individually necessary: deleting any one admits a natural-number model of every remaining premise.
findings.disposition: The actual Lean declaration retains all three guards, and the ordinary proof derives them from actual anchors and B4. Scalar formalization must not be presented as verification of that geometric derivation.

revisions.action: Tested weakened scalar interfaces and compared their premises with the ordinary B4 argument.
revisions.result: The formal/ordinary boundary remains necessary and explicitly preserved.

revisions.action: Constructed the committed Alpha rho-eight boundary example independently from literal triples.
revisions.result: The derived support bound remains restricted to rho<=6; no universal eleven-point cutoff is asserted.

checks.method: Read LOW15-R15-rho7-classification.md and manuscript Sections 5.2–6; independently formed the separated P8-i2 plus shifted H7 model from literal catalogue entries.
checks.observation: None of the 455 triples of members is a sunflower; the family has 15 members, support 13, minimum used degree 1 and rho 8. This reproduces Alpha alpha-counterexample-001 and refutes unrestricted support<=11 or minimum-degree>=3 claims. The manuscript assumes rho<=6 before those reductions and restricts R16-minus-one classification to exact rho7, so the example lies outside both domains.

checks.method: Inspected D16-fibre-independent-preparation.md and d16_fibre_reconstruction.cpp:118–131; compared literal weighted deletion sets with masks for all 256 A3 occupied supports.
checks.observation: All 16384 inclusion comparisons agree. For t=(2,1,0,0,1,0,0,0), D6 contains the fibre 1 member while D3 contains two fibre 0 members: q6<=q3 but D6 is not contained in D3. This confirms Alpha alpha-d16-001. The implementation uses mask inclusion and separately sums full multiplicities, avoiding the invalid replacement. This control is not a feasible complete degree16-star claim.

checks.scope: Necessity and fidelity of the formal hub guards
checks.method: Read hub_deletion_scalar_impossible and the ordinary hub-deletion note, equations (4)–(8); enumerated the bounded natural-number premise domain.
checks.observation: The unguarded inequalities admit 50 states; all three guards leave none. Removing guardp, guardq or guardr respectively admits (p,q,r)=(1,0,0),(0,1,0),(0,0,1), with t=2 and a=b=c=1. Each satisfies both retained guards. The budget forces t<=2 and the lower bound forces c<=7, so the enumerated range 0..8 covers the scalar domain. The ordinary proof supplies the guards using three surviving anchors and retains root pairs p0i; the Lean source assumes these guards explicitly.
